label: JUDGMENT
source: JUDGMENT: engineering judgment fixed by the coordinator in docs/PLAN_M5_M8.md, section 'M8 uncertainty' (2026-10-07), revised by 'Amendment R4' (R4-5, R4-6; 2026-10-13). These 1-sigma widths are NOT published values; NASA's NESC F-16 package gives no uncertainty for its aerodynamic tables.
version_note: v2 (amendment R4): the pitching-moment table is split into its static part (Cm_basic, cmt at el = 0) and the elevator increment (Cm_de, cmt - cmt(el = 0)), sigma 0.05 each, d = 2 (R4-5); the field of Cn_r is named Cn_r (R4-6). v1 (R3) had pitchStatic = {Cm_table} (d = 1) and the field Cnr_table.
rationale: Damping (rotary) derivatives are less certain than static tables, so their sigma is doubled (0.10 vs 0.05).
distribution: independent normal N(1, sigma) per multiplier (Monte Carlo)
coverage_note: per group: box half-width k_g * sigma with k_g = sqrt(chi2inv(coverage, d)), d = number of parameters in the group, so the box contains the group's 99 % joint ellipsoid; the full box is the product of the group boxes
multiplier_note: Each parameter is an AeroScale multiplier (vital.aircraft.f16.config) on ONE term of the NASA aero model about the MRC (35 % MAC); it is not a CG-derivative uncertainty (ADR R2-5). Cm_basic scales cmt(el = 0, alpha) (Cm0 and the static slope about the MRC); Cm_de scales cmt(el, alpha) - cmt(el = 0, alpha) (the elevator power).
